resource_inventory.scope: Darwin 23 IORegistry resource enumeration; no MMIO, firmware, DMA or transport
resource_inventory.evidence: WOA/edk2-msm DT resource names cross-checked against the Polaris board tree

cpu_timer_gic.evidence: Darwin 23 source-kernel platform milestone and QEMU/native timer checks

ufs.evidence: ShengUfs SDM845 read-only takeover code; no disposable iOS root boot

framebuffer.evidence: DarwinBoot consumes UEFI GOP; PolarisDisplayContract now records panel candidates and geometry, but no polaris Darwin 23 display provider exists

touch.evidence: GPIO33/GPIO34 RMI4 runtime plus the gated PolarisHidInput bridge against the pinned iPadOS 17.7.11 IOHID ABI; no independent Darwin 23 temporary-boot log or input-event trace

gpu_adreno630.evidence: Board windows, interrupts, chip ID and stream IDs are read from the stock Polaris DT (qcom,chipid=0x06030001, GPU 0x05000000+0x40000, GMU 0x0506a000+0x30000, GPU SMMU 0x05040000+0x10000, SIDs 0/1/2). The probe performs no MMIO, firmware load, DMA or SMMU programming; the upstream Adreno740 component is incompatible with SDM845/A630 and the local A642L reference needs its procedures re-derived.

wifi_wcn3998.evidence: PolarisTransportContracts now includes bounded WLFW and H4 codec cores; no Darwin UART/ICNSS transport, power sequence, firmware download or network data path is enabled

bluetooth_wcn3998.evidence: PolarisTransportContracts now includes bounded H4 command/event/ACL framing; no Darwin UART baud setup, firmware/NVM download, HCI transport or BlueTool bridge is enabled

camera.evidence: PolarisCameraContract and PolarisPeripheralContracts publish CCI/CSIPHY/CSID and IMX363 probe facts, but sensor power, CSI and ISP bring-up are not implemented

nfc.evidence: PolarisNfcContract and PolarisPeripheralContracts publish PN54x/NCI resource facts, but I2C/GPIO transport and secure-element integration are not implemented

buttons.evidence: PolarisPmicRuntime read-only PM8998 PON/GPIO6 polling; HID sink and temporary Darwin validation remain open

battery.evidence: PolarisPmicRuntime read-only PMI8998 revision-gated fuel-gauge source; charger state and temporary Darwin validation remain open
